title: FEDformer: Frequency Enhanced Decomposed Transformer for Long-term Series Forecasting
layout_note: Two-row snake: input and q on the top row, down by F to the frequency row, rightwards through sampling, the product with R and padding, then up by F^{-1} to the time-domain output on the top row.
grouping: No containers: seven tensor blocks in two rows. The top row holds time-domain tensors (input, q, output y), the bottom row the frequency-domain ones (Q, sampled Q̃, Ỹ, padded Y); the learnable weight R sits alone above the bottom row in a different colour.
shapes_depth: Each tensor is a box with a small 3-D depth face, filled light green for real-valued and saturated green for complex-valued tensors, the weight R cyan; each box carries its own set-and-shape label inside (q ∈ R^{L×D}, Q ∈ C^{N×D}, R ∈ C^{M×D×D}). Arrows are labelled with the operation: MLP, the Fourier symbol going down, 'Sampling', 'padding', the inverse Fourier symbol going up. The product is a grey circle with a large ×.
proposed_highlight: The whole figure is the proposed block; the learnable frequency-domain weight R is the only cyan element, and the domain switch is shown by the change from R to C in the shape labels and the darker green.
lesson: Put time-domain tensors on the top row and frequency-domain tensors on the bottom row, with the Fourier transform as the arrow going down and its inverse as the arrow coming back up, and mark each tensor ℝ or ℂ in its shape label so the domain is read from row and symbol.
notes: Venue and year from the PDF first-page footer (ICML 2022).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: frequency-enhanced block for long-term forecasting (Fourier variant)

insights.structure: Seven unframed 3-D tensor blocks in two rows: time-domain tensors (q, output y) on the top row, frequency-domain tensors (Q, sampled Q~, Y~, padded Y) on the bottom row, with the learnable weight R alone above the bottom row.
insights.data: Each tensor is an extruded green box with its shape written inside (q in R^{LxD}, Q in C^{NxD}, R in C^{MxDxD}); the input X^{l-1} is a small flat box, and the product is a grey circled X.
insights.emphasis: The learnable weight R is the only cyan block, and the domain change shows in both the darker green of the bottom row and the switch from R to C in the shape labels.
insights.flow: A snake: input -> MLP -> q on top, down by the F arrow, rightwards through Sampling, the product with R and padding, then up by the F^{-1} arrow to y on the top right.
insights.avoid: The math labels inside the blocks are small and the trailing grey output arrow at the far right ends unlabelled.

arrangement.units: no enclosures; two rows of 3-D tensor blocks (time domain on top, frequency domain below)
